fields.title: Sen'i Tōsei oyobi Shōgyō Unei Keiyaku

contract.subject: Sen'i ryūtsū to shōgyō kyoka no kitei

agreement.purpose: Sen'i shijō no kanzen na tōsei to gunji yōsei e no kyōryoku.
terms: Gyōsei chōkan no meirei ni yori shōgyō kyoka wa itsu demo torikeshi kanō de aru.
Kōshō hiyō wa tōsei kitei ni shitagatte chōshū sareru.

party_a: Tōsei kitei to kyoka jōken o junju suru koto.
party_b: Hitsuyō ni ōji te kyoka o seigen suru kenri o yū suru.

claims.fact: Keiyaku sho wa kyoka no torikeshi ga gyōsei meirei ni yori gōhōteki ni okonawareru koto o shōmei shite iru.
